Octopus.//: Where the factory follows a merged change to production: the Octopus project the Release workflow of cmdemo1-workorders creates releases of. The API key is a secret: Octopus__ApiKey. tdd and uat switch this off (Octopus__Enabled false in system.json): only prod works the board.

AIWorkers.//AiToolColumns: The board's Status options the factory works, in order. Each needs a prompt Prompts/cursor/cursor-<column>.md (column name lowercased, letters only); the packages supply these. A person moves an item into Technical Design to hand it to the factory. More columns (Conceptual Definition, UX Design, Test Design) can be added here and on the board without a code change.
AIWorkers.//DisableFactoryAutoMerge: Merging is on for this factory: on a PASS verdict it approves and squash-merges the pull request of an item that carries the 'Auto Merge' label. An item without the label waits for a person to merge. Remove this line to turn merging off again (the packages' default).
AIWorkers.//HoldColumns: A card waits in Release Queue from the release candidate until the change is in production: the factory adds no Ready To Move there, and its deployment handler moves the item to Done at a successful production deployment. Without this the factory moves a card out of any column it does not work, and Done would mean merged, not delivered.
AIWorkers.//ReleaseCandidatePublishCheckName: The job of the Release workflow of cmdemo1-workorders. A merge that builds no release (documentation only) skips that job; the factory then finishes the item instead of waiting 20 minutes for a release candidate (Aisf 0.1.0-alpha.37).
